# Promptfolio by Ben McNulty

> A curated portfolio of 39 Custom GPT experiments for work, conversation, and art, plus a preserved 2024 writing archive about AI interaction design.

Promptfolio is authored by Ben McNulty. Catalog entries link to Custom GPTs hosted by ChatGPT. The articles retain their original publication dates and historical context; older product capability statements should not be treated as freshly validated claims.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.promptfolio.dev/): Project introduction and featured work.
- [Custom GPT catalog](https://www.promptfolio.dev/listing): The complete, searchable collection of 39 GPT experiments.
- [Writing](https://www.promptfolio.dev/blog): A 2026 modernization case study and nine historical essays originally published in 2024.
- [About](https://www.promptfolio.dev/about): Project purpose, implementation, and author context.
- [Privacy](https://www.promptfolio.dev/privacy): Hosting, storage, and external-link privacy details.
